hooks.command: R="tools/aiwf-hooks/aiwf_prompt_router.py"; [ -f "$R" ] || R=".agents/aiwf-hooks/aiwf_prompt_router.py"; [ -f "$R" ] || exit 0; for PY in python3 python "py -3"; do $PY -c "import sys" >/dev/null 2>&1 && break; PY=""; done; [ -n "$PY" ] || exit 0; $PY "$R"

G="tools/aiwf-hooks/claude_source_write_guard.py"; [ -f "$G" ] || G=".agents/aiwf-hooks/claude_source_write_guard.py"; [ -f "$G" ] || exit 0; for PY in python3 python "py -3"; do $PY -c "import sys" >/dev/null 2>&1 && break; PY=""; done; [ -n "$PY" ] || exit 0; $PY "$G"
